title: Transfers and Servicing
summary: Addresses the accounting for transfers of financial assets, including the derecognition criteria and servicing arrangements.
description: ASC 860 governs the accounting for transfers of financial assets, establishing criteria for sale accounting versus secured borrowing treatment. It requires isolated assets, transferee rights to pledge/exchange, and absence of effective control by the transferor for derecognition. The standard also addresses servicing assets and liabilities, and repurchase agreements.

bannerNotice.title: Key IFRS 9 Divergence
bannerNotice.body: ASC 860 uses a control-based test as the sole gatekeeping analysis for derecognition, whereas IFRS 9 primarily uses a risks-and-rewards test, falling back to control only in specific circumstances. This structural divergence means identical transfers can produce different balance-sheet outcomes under US GAAP and IFRS.
